I have only a small piece of land for tubers this season, just 0.05 hectares that I intercrop with other crops to make the most of it. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for such a small plot when my family needs that money for food and school fees, but I have some manure from our goats and chickens that I will spread to give the soil strength. I will use the same cassava cuttings and yam setts I saved from last year's harvest because buying new planting material is too costly, and I do not need to waste money on pesticides or irrigation when the rains are coming and my family can weed by hand. My wife and children will work this plot together over the season, and it is small enough that we do not need to hire anyone from outside.
